The [[White Wolf]] is a [[charmable animal]] found in the snowy regions of the [[Far Shiverpeaks]].

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
***{{NPC location|Drakkar Lake}} (a single White ''or'' [[Black Wolf]] [[spawn]]s at the [[Shrine of the Wolf Spirit]])
***{{NPC location|Hero Tutorial}} (see Notes)
***{{NPC location|Varajar Fells}} (southeastern corner)

==Notes==
*White Wolves deal [[slashing damage]].
*[[Zaishen Menagerie Grounds/Service costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''
*Charmable during the unrepeatable [[Hero Tutorial]] quest, only if you have [[Charm Animal]] equipped on a [[hero]] in your party or use heroes to pull the wolves.
